firmwares.avant: mkdir -p build/gen build/emu && (python3 tools/gen_font.py build/gen/felucca_font.h || python3 tools/gen_font_noraqm.py tools/gen_font.py build/gen/felucca_font.h) && python3 tools/gen_words.py firmware/words.tsv web/words build/gen/ann_words.h
firmwares.construction: $ZIG cc -target wasm32-wasi -mexec-model=reactor -O2 -g0 -ffp-contract=off -std=gnu99 -w -DEN_HOST -DEN_WEB '-DEN_VERSION="1.0.0"' -Ifirmware/src -Ifirmware/src/dsp -Ibuild/gen -Wl,--strip-debug -Wl,--export-dynamic -Wl,-z,stack-size=1048576 -Wl,--initial-memory=33554432 -o build/emu/amb.wasm web/emu/amb_web.c firmware/src/dsp/amb.c && cp web/emu/worklet.js build/emu/
